core.title: Modern 18 Inch Square Shower Door Pull, Pair, SGS SDQ-018

text.description_html:
Modern 18" Glass Door Pull

The Modern 18 Inch Square Shower Door Pull can be used, as the name suggests, as a shower door handle but it can also be used on nearly any glass door including those for offices. It comes packaged as a pair of pulls with the all the necessary mounting hardware for glass door installation. The contemporary square design paired with the available finish choices make it great for modern homes and offices. Choose from satin nickel, polished chrome, and oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching 18" Square Pull for metal or wood doors.

Specifications and Features of the 18" Square Door Pull:

  • Overall Length: 18-3/4"
  • Mounting Length: 18" Center to Center
  • Pull Diameter: 3/4" Square Tubing
  • Overall Projection: 2-13/32"
  • Clearance: 1-5/8"
  • Inner Contact Tubing: 5/8" (16 mm)
  • For 5/16" (8 mm) to 1/2" (12 mm) thick glass
  • Hole in Glass Diameter: 1/2" (12 mm) Minimum
  • Comes packaged as a back-to-back pair with mounting hardware for glass doors.

Sold as a Pair (2 door pull handles) for Glass Door.
